# IC-7851/IC-7850 — the ALLOWED CITATIONS of core/driver/ic7851 and core/civ/ic7851.
#
# This list is the POSITIVE half of the provenance pins. The blacklist beside
# it (core/driver/ic7851/provenance_test.go) names literals a rejected branch
# actually copied from another radio; a paraphrase walks past it. This list
# asks the other question, and it is the one the tier review asked for: of
# every document citation these two packages make, can this model's OWN
# authority supply it? A citation not written here fails the test, and the
# answer is to check the authority — never to widen the list to fit the prose.
#
# The authority, named by core/driver/ic7851/doc.go verbatim:
#
#   "There is NO standalone CI-V reference guide for this model. The whole
#    authority is
#        IC-7850/IC-7851 Instruction Manual, Revision 3,
#        document code A7205H-1EX-3, 283 PDF pages, (c) 2015-2018 Icom Inc.
#    Its CI-V material is Section 18, "CONTROL COMMAND", which is PDF pages
#    250-265 (printed folios 18-1 to 18-16)."
#
# and its reading, "the IC-7851 capability matrix trio under
# docs/superpowers/icom-matrices/ (ic7851-capability-matrix.md rev 1 plus
# Errata 1-15, its report, and its Approved-with-fixes review)", together with
# docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-28-icom-ic7851.md.
#
# FORMAT. One canonical citation token per line; "#" starts a comment, and a
# token may carry a trailing note. The tokens are produced by
# core/driver/internal/drivertest.ScanCitations, whose grammar and the two
# shapes it deliberately omits are documented in citations.go.
#
# WHERE THE AUTHORITY IS ABSENT. docs/superpowers/ is gitignored, so a fresh
# clone and CI do not have it (the v1.2.1 CI run, 30/08/2026). This list is
# checked in and is ALWAYS enforced; the supply check against the authority
# runs only where the authority is present, and logs a skip where it is not.
